**Observation Log:**

[FACT] Session Date: 2023/05/24 (Wed) 20:12  
[EVENT] Wukong arrives at a camp where his people are imprisoned.  
[FACT] The camp conditions are described as cramped and dirty.  
[FACT] The other Simians in the camp look emaciated and defeated.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Jaedala tells Wukong's people that they are there to serve the Luxian Empire.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Jaedala states that those who cooperate will be rewarded, while those who do not will be punished.  
[FACT] Wukong feels distress at the conditions of the camp and the treatment of his people.  
[RELATIONSHIP] Wukong is referred to as the prince by Jaedala.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Jaedala orders Wukong to say a few words to his imprisoned people.  
[FACT] Wukong is reluctant to speak in front of his people due to Jaedala's presence.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Wukong tries to convey hope to his people while appearing submissive to Jaedala.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Wukong's speech includes phrases like "do not lose hope" and "we are a strong and resilient people."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Wukong begs Jaedala for mercy on his people, asking her to show them kindness.  
[FACT] Jaedala reacts angrily to Wukong's words and pulls him away from the crowd.  
[EVENT] Sanzang, Wukong's best friend, stands up and yells at Wukong in despair and anger.  
[RELATIONSHIP] Sanzang is identified as Wukong's best friend.  
[FACT] Sanzang questions Wukong about what "they" did to him.  
[FACT] Jaedala looks at Sanzang angrily after he speaks out.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Wukong apologizes to Sanzang and reassures him that he is working on a way to help them.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Wukong encourages his people to not give up hope and to find a way to fight back.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Wukong's speech includes the message that they will find a way to be free again.  
[EVENT] Wukong feels a surge of hope as murmurs of approval arise from the crowd after his speech.
